given: uptime autodetect checks robots.txt for URLs pulled from customer event data with urllib.robotparser, which fetches through raw urllib instead of Sentry's SSRF-safe HTTP stack

should_find.finding: get_robots_txt_parser / check_url_robots_txt fetch robots.txt for event-derived URLs through RobotFileParser.read (raw urllib), bypassing safe_urlopen and its restricted-IP checks, so an attacker-supplied URL makes Sentry request internal or cloud metadata addresses (SSRF)
